section_summary: This section records Japanese requests for port visits by naval transports loading crude petroleum in California, and U.S. deliberations over whether requisitioned ships qualified for naval courtesies and immunities. It also contains changes to visit schedules, a canceled visit, and Navy reports of suspected intelligence gathering by the tanker Iro and another Japanese vessel in Los Angeles Harbor.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note no. 134 on Hoyo Maru
subfiles.about: Requests approval and usual courtesies for Hoyo Maru's June 3–6 petroleum loading at Estero Bay.
subfiles.summary: Requests permission for the visit and crew landing.

subfiles.title: State Department notice to Secretary of War on Toei Maru
subfiles.about: Seeks usual courtesies for Toei Maru's June visit to Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Relays the Japanese request for a crude oil loading visit.

subfiles.title: State Department notice to California governor on Hoyo Maru
subfiles.about: Seeks usual courtesies for Hoyo Maru at Estero Bay.
subfiles.summary: Advises the governor of the proposed petroleum loading visit.

subfiles.title: State Department notice to Attorney General on Toei Maru
subfiles.about: Seeks usual courtesies for Toei Maru's Los Angeles visit.
subfiles.summary: Relays the transport's planned June 6–9 crude oil loading.

subfiles.title: State Department notice to Secretary of Agriculture on Toei Maru
subfiles.about: Seeks usual courtesies for Toei Maru's Los Angeles visit.
subfiles.summary: Reports the Japanese request and planned crude oil loading.

subfiles.title: State Department notice to California governor on Toei Maru
subfiles.about: Seeks usual courtesies for Toei Maru in Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Notifies the governor of the proposed June 6–9 visit.

subfiles.title: State Department notice to Secretary of the Navy on Hoyo Maru
subfiles.about: Requests Navy consideration of Hoyo Maru's Estero Bay visit and crew landing.
subfiles.summary: Asks whether Navy objects and whether customary facilities may be extended.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Japanese note no. 134
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the Hoyo Maru request pending replies from federal authorities.
subfiles.summary: Promises a further response after consultation.

subfiles.title: Treasury response on Hoyo Maru
subfiles.from: Herbert E. Gaston, Assistant Secretary of the Treasury
subfiles.about: Reports that Treasury took no action on customs courtesies for Hoyo Maru after receiving later informal information.
subfiles.summary: Treasury did not act on the May 22 request.

subfiles.title: State Department reply on Hoyo Maru's status
subfiles.about: Addresses the public naval vessel status claimed for Hoyo Maru and port procedures before Estero Bay.
subfiles.summary: The Department asks for further information if Japan seeks full public vessel status. The OCR of the concluding instructions is damaged, but it directs the ship to comply with usual Port San Luis regulations before proceeding to Estero Bay.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Iguchi about Hoyo Maru
subfiles.about: Records Adams explaining the Department's position on Hoyo Maru by telephone to Iguchi.
subfiles.summary: After Iguchi sought a prompt answer, Adams conveyed the Department's position by telephone. Iguchi later requested a written version because he had difficulty understanding English over the telephone.

subfiles.title: Protocol memorandum on draft Embassy reply
subfiles.about: Records Commander McCracken's objections to wording a proposed reply about Japanese special transports.
subfiles.summary: McCracken favored requesting advance notice and naval personnel names.

subfiles.title: Navy Department opinion on Kokuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Questions whether Kokuyo Maru qualifies as a Japanese naval vessel entitled to warship courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Navy asks for proof of the vessel's status and opposes public warship privileges if it is a cargo ship with a naval inspector.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note no. 124 on Kokuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Requests approval, crew landing, and courtesies for Kokuyo Maru's May 27–30 Los Angeles visit.
subfiles.summary: The transport was to load crude petroleum.

subfiles.title: Protocol file memorandum on Kokuyo Maru's entry
subfiles.about: Records the Embassy's decision that Kokuyo Maru would enter Los Angeles as a commercial vessel.
subfiles.summary: State required more evidence for naval status; the Embassy chose commercial entry.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note no. 135 on Toei Maru
subfiles.about: Requests approval, crew landing, and courtesies for Toei Maru's June 6–9 Los Angeles visit.
subfiles.summary: The transport planned to load crude petroleum.

subfiles.title: State Department notice to Attorney General on Toei Maru
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Toei Maru's Los Angeles call.
subfiles.summary: Relays the Japanese note and planned oil loading.

subfiles.title: State Department notice to Secretary of War on Toei Maru
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Toei Maru's Los Angeles call.
subfiles.summary: Relays the June 6–9 proposed visit.

subfiles.title: State Department notice to Secretary of Agriculture on Toei Maru
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Toei Maru's Los Angeles call.
subfiles.summary: Reports the planned crude oil loading visit.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Japanese note no. 135
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the Toei Maru request pending consultation with federal authorities.
subfiles.summary: Promises a further reply.

subfiles.title: State Department reply on Toei Maru's status
subfiles.about: States conditions for recognizing Toei Maru as a public naval vessel.
subfiles.summary: State requests more evidence for naval status but sees no objection to entry as a commercial vessel.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note no. 181 changing Kokuyo Maru's schedule
subfiles.about: Changes Kokuyo Maru's Los Angeles visit to July 8–11.
subfiles.summary: Asks State to notify the relevant authorities.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs memorandum on Hoyo Maru
subfiles.about: Proposes an oral response to Japan's request for public vessel treatment of special transports.
subfiles.summary: The memorandum explains that requisitioned vessels with naval inspectors ordinarily do not receive public vessel courtesies unless fully manned by naval crews. It recommends maintaining that practice while considering proposed port visits without public naval vessel privileges.

subfiles.title: Embassy aide-mémoire on Hoyo Maru at Port San Luis
subfiles.about: Advises that Hoyo Maru will call at Port San Luis for quarantine and customs procedures.
subfiles.summary: The call was planned for June 3 before Estero Bay.

subfiles.title: Status of Japanese Naval Special Transports
subfiles.about: Explains Japan's claimed naval status for requisitioned special transports.
subfiles.summary: It describes onboard naval inspectors, other naval personnel, and inclusion on the Japanese naval ships list.

subfiles.title: Schedule of Japanese transport port calls
subfiles.about: Lists California port calls and dates for Toei Maru, Kokuyo Maru, Hoyo Maru, and other transports.
subfiles.summary: Shows San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Estero Bay calls.

subfiles.title: Navy response on Shiriya
subfiles.about: Reports no Navy objection to Shiriya's proposed Los Angeles visit and crew landing.
subfiles.summary: The August 9–14 visit was for crude oil loading.

subfiles.title: Immigration Service response on Shiriya
subfiles.about: Confirms that Los Angeles immigration officials were asked to extend customary courtesies to Shiriya.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the planned August 9–14 petroleum loading visit.

subfiles.title: Japanese Embassy note no. 233 postponing Shiriya
subfiles.about: Postpones Shiriya's arrival indefinitely and withdraws a request for an oil payment funds license.
subfiles.summary: The scheduled August 9 Los Angeles call would not proceed as planned.

subfiles.title: Far Eastern Affairs memorandum on Erimo's arrival
subfiles.about: Recommends withholding approval for Erimo's Los Angeles visit after its premature arrival at San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: The memorandum proposes addressing the advance approval requirement with the Embassy.

subfiles.title: Protocol memorandum on Erimo
subfiles.about: Reports Embassy calls concerning permission for Erimo and its arrival in San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: The Embassy said the vessel had anchored before Los Angeles permission was granted.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Okumura about Kokuyo Maru
subfiles.about: Records Okumura's request for naval courtesies after Kokuyo Maru arrived at Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Okumura said Kokuyo Maru had not received courtesies previously given to similar transports. Coville explained that State had allowed entry without public naval vessel immunities pending further evidence of status. Okumura agreed to seek supporting information from Japanese officials.

subfiles.title: Adams letter to Iguchi on special transport status
subfiles.about: Confirms the U.S. position on public vessel courtesies for Japanese requisitioned transports.
subfiles.summary: Adams explains that requisitioned ships with naval inspectors do not qualify for public vessel status under existing U.S. practice unless fully manned by naval crews. The Department requests advance notice of visits and lists of naval personnel aboard.

subfiles.title: Treasury customs authorization for Iro
subfiles.about: Authorizes Los Angeles customs officials to extend usual facilities to tanker Iro.
subfiles.summary: The proposed visit was July 9–14 for crude oil loading.

subfiles.title: Protocol memorandum on Shiriya inquiry
subfiles.about: Reports a Navy inquiry about Shiriya's planned August visit to Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Lieutenant Gary called concerning the crude oil loading visit.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference on diverted Japanese ships
subfiles.about: Points to another file concerning Japanese ships diverted from U.S. ports.
subfiles.summary: Cites a letter in file 894.85/646.

subfiles.title: Navy covering letter on port courtesies abuses
subfiles.about: Forwards confidential Navy reports on alleged abuse of port courtesies by Japanese naval vessels.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Eleventh Naval District correspondence and comments.

subfiles.title: Assistant Commandant report on port courtesies
subfiles.about: Reports suspicious photography and boat drills by Japanese vessels near naval and shipbuilding facilities.
subfiles.summary: The report describes Iro crew activity near Bethlehem's San Pedro shipbuilding ways and a previous Kokuyo Maru boat movement near anti-submarine nets. Coffman considers the intelligence value small but calls the conduct irritating.

subfiles.title: Branch Intelligence Office memorandum on Iro photography
subfiles.from: M. F. Heslip for K. D. Ringle
subfiles.about: Reports crew photography of the Los Angeles shipyard from tanker Iro.
subfiles.summary: The office took no action because of the vessel's naval status.
